environment.description: Service deployed behind an Istio ingress gateway (v1.19) with PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mode at mesh level. The gateway's VirtualService routes to the backend only after Envoy validates the downstream connection's XFCC header contains a SPIFFE URI matching spiffe://cluster.local/ns/frontend/sa/webapp-client. Additionally, an AuthorizationPolicy resource on the workload requires the source principal to be cluster.local/ns/frontend/sa/webapp-client for all paths EXCEPT /health. The Istio sidecar's iptables rules intercept all inbound traffic on port 8080, meaning no direct pod-to-pod connection bypasses the mTLS handshake. The frontend service account's RBAC only permits GET /cache/{key} operations — DELETE and POST /cache/evict are not in the allowed method/path combinations in the AuthorizationPolicy.

config.ingress: Istio IngressGateway with XFCC validation for spiffe://cluster.local/ns/frontend/sa/webapp-client
config.default_deny: AuthorizationPolicy with action DENY for unmatched requests
